overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Consumer Staples 2x Daily ETF (XLPX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer staples equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR Fund (Ticker: XLP), which provides exposure to US consumer-staples stocks. XLPX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
